parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units for activities against human single-protein targets. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter target_dictionary.organism for human and target_dictionary.target_type for single protein. Filter activities.standard_type for Ki and activities.standard_value below 100. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Limit to 500 rows.
